a: Up to $1M over up to 4 years; typical $150-250K/yr
dt: Accepted anytime; target dates first Thursday of Feb and second Thursday of Sept
e: CISE's consolidated core solicitation; the FET program funds computing based on emerging technologies (quantum computing and information, novel devices and physical substrates for computation), and SHF/CIF cover hardware and information theory. Open to US universities; no citizenship restriction.
n: NSF CISE Future Computing Research (Future CoRe, NSF 25-543): Foundations of Emerging Technologies (FET) and related programs
